$comment: One rule, three clients (docs/coordinator-handoff-v2-design.md §4): a coordinator conversation does not draw a record (answered question, decision receipt, merge line, blocked promotion) stamped before the conversation was created. 'head' stays for a record after its creation but older than its oldest loaded row. Open items are not records and are drawn as before. A successor's handoff note card counts the decisions and merges before it. Read by web decisionReceipt.test.ts, OrbitKit CoordinatorCleanStartTests and Android CoordinatorCleanStartTest.
